subject: English
question_text: Choose the best answer from the alternatives.
stimulus: ⎯ a. The most colorful festival of Pahela Boishakh is held in . (i) Dhaka (ii) Rajshahi (iii) Magura (iv) Khulna b. The cultural show of Pahela Boishakh starts with the songs of ⎯. (i) Kazi Narzrul Islam (ii) Lalon Shah (iii) Rabindranath Tagore (iv) Hason Raza c. The first day of ⎯ new year is known as Pahela Baishakh. (i) English (ii) Arabic (iii) Bangla (iv) Urdu ⎯ d. People join the colorful processions organized by the students. (i) Science (ii) Commerce (iii) Arts (iv) Fine Arts ⎯ e. The cultural function at Ramna Batamul is organized by . (i) Chhyanata (ii) Chhatra League (iii) Chhatradal (iv) Chhatra Union f. The day gives inspiration to _ to start life with renewed hopes and aspirations. (i) students (ii) people (iii) the teachers (iv) the rich g. The day is celebrated ⎯. (i) democratically (ii) internationally (iii) dramatically (iv) traditionally
guide_solution: a. (i) Dhaka; b. (iii) Rabindranath Tagore; c. (iii) Bangla; d. (iv) Fine Arts; e. (i) Chhyanata; f. (ii) people; g. (iv) traditionally; h. (iv) early in the morning; i. (iii) just with sunrise; j. (iv) all over the country.

subject: English
stimulus: a. What do you mean by Pahela Boishakh? b. How do the women adorn themselves? c. What does the day inspire people? d. What do the men put on? e. How is the day observed in Dhaka? ✕
guide_solution: a. Pahela Boishakh is the first day of Bangla New Year. b. The women put on white saris with red borders and adorn themselves with colourful churis ad flowers. c. The day inspires people to start life with renewed hopes and aspirations. d. The men put on pajamas and Punjabis. e. The day is observed in colourful manner in Dhaka. f. The day is celebrated traditionally every year. g. People get up early in the morning, take a bath and wear their traditional clothes. h. On this day, people love to eat traditional foods. i. The cultural programme starts just with sunrise. j. The procession displays the traditional practices of Bangalee culture.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Seen Passage — Unit—4: Events and Festivals, Lesson—6: Pohela Boishakh
